description: Total greenhouse-gas emissions by INDUSTRY SECTOR within a US state (EPA GHGRP), answers 'which sectors emit the most in <state>'. Sectors: Power Plants, Refineries, Chemicals, Metals, Minerals, Pulp and Paper, Petroleum and Natural Gas Systems, Waste, etc. Returns each sector's total metric tons CO2e and facility count, ranked. State-scoped (pass a state); data lags ~1.5y so the latest full year (~2023) is auto-selected unless `year` is given.

sector.description: Optional, filter to one sector by name (e.g. "Power Plants", "Refineries", "Chemicals").

state.description: US state, 2-letter code ("TX") or full name ("Texas"). Required (state-scoped, not national).

name: ghg_emissions_by_sector

total_ghg_emissions_mt_co2e.description: Total GHG emissions in metric tons CO2 equivalent

found.description: Present and true on an answer; a miss is the found:false branch.

facility_count.description: Number of facilities in this sector

total_emissions_mt_co2e.description: Aggregated emissions for sector in metric tons CO2e

oneOf.description: A miss or an unavailable upstream: found:false with a reason and a hint (the shape check-found-false-schemas.mjs expects).

title: Ghg Emissions By Sector
